items.headline: I got 3× faster HFQ4 prefill on Strix Halo in hipfire with an opt-in MMQ path
items.summary: I recently contributed an experimental HFQ4-G256 MMQ prefill path to hipfire, an RDNA-focused LLM inference engine. Disclaimer: I authored the PR, so this is partly a contribution note, but I am mainly looking for independent validation from other AMD users. Before this PR, HFQ4 prefill in hipfire was going through a more generic/slower path. items.headline: PullMD - gave Claude Code an MCP server so it stops burning tokens parsing HTML
items.summary: Hey all, Built this over the past few weeks because I got tired of two things: 1. Mobile copy-paste is awful. Long Reddit thread or blog post on my phone, want to ask Claude about it.
